verdict.rationale: Check's own docs say it handles taxes, money movement, and the production and filing of tax forms, and its site lists tax filing and tax notices, so automated payroll-tax handling is a first-party capability. The evidence is high-level and does not spell out the jurisdictional coverage or the remittance mechanics the story requires. Missing for 10: explicit federal, state, and local jurisdiction coverage, documented tax calculation and remittance workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: We handle the intricacies of taxes, money movement, and the production and filing of tax forms so that you can focus on building the best product for your customers.
